title: Yanis Varoufakis: The Global Minotaur: America, Europe and the Future of the Global Economy
summary: Yanis Varoufakis talks at a festival in Zagreb about his book The Global Minotaur. He argues the postwar global economy and the 2008 crisis stem from deeper structural causes than greed or weak regulation.
why: HN recommends it as a narrative of a century of political economy and the geopolitics behind the 2008 crash.

quote.text: a nice narrative of the last 100 years of the political economy
